thread:
Tara B: Heads up from usability testing: when reviewers collapse similar diffs in the regression view they lose the original prompt context. People expect to review one canonical response + the prompt, but the compact rows only show a one-line summary.
Miles R: Hmm, that's bad. Do we collapse responses server-side or in the client?
Tara B: Client groups by hash and shows a count + representative snippet. Users then click into the group and the detailed pane shows the prompt + one response, but testers wanted to compare the prompt against all representative variants without extra clicks.
Jun K: Are they asking for an expanded inline preview in the compact list? That could get noisy.
Priya V: Design idea: keep the compact rows but add a hover/expand affordance that reveals the full prompt and up to 3 representative responses inline. Label each response with a tiny badge (A/B/C) and allow keyboard focus.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: any hover-only affordance must also be keyboard-accessible and announced. Provide a visible affordance (chevron) and an aria-expanded toggle. For the inline previews, use role="group" and make each snippet focusable.
Miles R: Performance note: fetching 3 reps per group could be lazy-loaded on expand. Server can return representative IDs in the list payload so client can request content on demand.
Tara B: Copying UX note: when groups are collapsed, include a tooltip-like shortline: "3 similar responses" is fine, but when expanded we should show: "Prompt" header, then the three responses labelled and a CTA: "Open all in side panel".
Priya V: Microcopy candidates:
- collapsed badge: "3 variants"
- expand header: "Prompt"
- response labels: "Variant A" / "Variant B"
- CTA: "Open all variants"
Jun K: Implementation action: add rep_ids array to group model in the run diff API and a lightweight endpoint to fetch response bodies by ids.
Miles R: I'll scope the API change: rep_ids + sample_text fields. Client will lazy-fetch bodies for keyboard/hover expand. Will add cache TTL.
Tara B: Accessibility action items: keyboard affordance, aria-expanded, announce "n variants expanded" via polite live region, and avoid auto-expanding on mouseover only.
Priya V: I'll sketch two variants in #design: inline preview (3 snippets) and a compact popover that appears on chevron click. Will include keyboard flows and small-screen behavior.
Tara B: Product question: do we need to include the original prompt in the collapsed row itself? Testers liked seeing the prompt immediately. Maybe show a truncated prompt line under the snippet.
Miles R: We can include a 1-line truncated prompt in the collapsed row; fetching prompt text is cheap since it's part of the case object.
Tara B: Summary of next steps:
- Miles: API: add rep_ids and sample_text, lightweight fetch endpoint.
- Priya: two mocks + copy + mobile behavior.
- Jun: client: implement chevron expand + lazy-load + keyboard support.
- a11y-bot: aria checklist and live region snippets.
Tara B: Thanks all. If anyone sees edge cases (e.g., groups with very long prompts), drop them here and we'll decide truncation rules. :mag:
